fields.DESCRIPTION: Invoke blessings, wisdom, and prosperity into your home with this exquisite hand-painted Rajasthani Lord Ganesha idol. Crafted with care by skilled artisans of Rajasthan, this idol beautifully captures the divine presence of Lord Ganesha — the remover of obstacles and harbinger of success. The idol is made from high-quality marble and intricately hand-painted with traditional Rajasthani motifs in red, gold, and blue, showcasing the region’s vibrant artistry. Its fine detailing and colorful design make it a perfect blend of spirituality and craftsmanship.
